3:38.text: invoked his Lord, saying: "O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation."

3:39.text: Then the angels called him, while he was standing in prayer in Al-Mihrâb
(a praying place or a private room)
: "Allâh gives you glad tidings of Yahya
[i.e. the creation of ‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام, the Word from Allâh ("Be!" - and he was!)]
, noble, keeping away from sexual relations with women, a Prophet, from among the righteous."

3:40.text: He said: "O my Lord! How can I have a son when I am very old, and my wife is barren?"
said: "Thus Allâh does what He wills."

3:41.text: He said: "O my Lord! Make a sign for me." Allâh said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak to mankind for three days except with signals. And remember your Lord much
in the afternoon and in the morning.

3:42.text: ! Verily, Allâh has chosen you, purified you
, and chosen you above the women of the ‘Âlamîn

3:43.text: O Mary! "Submit yourself with obedience to your Lord
(Allâh, by worshipping none but Him Alone)

3:44.text: This is a part of the news of the Ghaib
(unseen, i.e. the news of the past nations of which you have no knowledge)
. You were not with them, when they cast lots with their pens as to which of them should be charged with the care of Maryam
; nor were you with them when they disputed.

3:45.text: ! Verily, Allâh gives you the glad tidings of a Word
["Be!" - and he was! i.e. ‘Îsâ (Jesus) the son of Maryam (Mary)]
from Him, his name will be the Messiah ‘Îsâ
, held in honour in this world and in the Hereafter, and will be one of those who are near to Allâh."
